hypotheses.justification: `[CharZero L]` is a theorem argument because it is instance-implicit and mentions only `L`, which is an argument. Nothing in the statement or the proof uses it. The statement `HahnSeries.C c = algebraMap L (LaurentSeries L) c` only needs a commutative ring structure on `L`; here `[Field L]` provides it. The proof is `rw [algebraMap_laurentSeries_eq_single, HahnSeries.C_apply]`. With `ModularCurve` open, the first name resolves to `ModularCurve.algebraMap_laurentSeries_eq_single` in `Definitions/Def_ModularCurve_LaurentCoeff.lean`, which assumes only `(L : Type*) [Field L]`. The file defines no local version of that lemma. `HahnSeries.C_apply` is a general Mathlib lemma with no characteristic assumption. The identity holds in every characteristic, so the same proof goes through unchanged after `omit [NeZero m] [CharZero L] in`.
